product_concept: A reliable turnover & property-operations kit for hosts with 1-5 listings: standardized cleaning/turnover checklists, a guest-ready house manual, and a supply-restock tracker — delivered so it won't break like the Canva templates hosts complain about.
core_problem: Airbnb hosts with 1-5 properties face a related cluster of problems around turnover & property operations — e.g. cleaner turnover coordination, supply restocking tracking, welcome book contents unclear.
related_problems: Coordinating and standardizing cleaner turnover between guests is hard.
Restocking supplies and consumables is easy to forget.
Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.
desired_outcome: A shared outcome across member problems: Standardize every turnover. Never run out of guest supplies. Produce a house manual without tool failures.
core_transformation: From error-prone, ad-hoc turnovers and unclear house manuals -> a standardized, reliable turnover system nothing falls through.
product_promise: Every turnover done the same way, nothing forgotten, no broken templates.
product_format: Bundle: fill-in templates / scripts + calculator / spreadsheet + guide / checklist
why_this_format: The job is repeatable operations + reference, so a checklist/tracker + house-manual bundle fits — not an ebook. Reliability (no save/print failures) is the wedge.
price_rationale: Observed: Etsy host welcome-book/checklist bundles sell at ~$14-21+; this sits in the proven band.
key_customer_language: what goes in a house manual
key_objections: I already bought a welcome-book template
I can make my own checklist
evidence_summary: Small Airbnb hosts repeatedly need a reliable turnover system (cleaning/turnover, a guest-ready house manual, supply restocking). Observed: hosts already pay for welcome-book/checklist templates on Etsy (1,000+ listings, many Bestsellers) and a real 1-star review shows those Canva templates failing to save/print — a reliability gap. Demand and spending are real; the open question is distribution, not whether the problem exists.
risks_unknowns: Distribution/promotion unproven (creator density MEDIUM, not qualified)
Welcome-book market saturated — must be visibly more reliable/complete
Some hosts use a property manager and won't buy tools
